alent: alent — beyond, on the far side of (apocopated allende; alent parte del mar 'beyond the sea'; = allende, allá de)
andon: andon — uncertain: printed in italics (a supplied word, no footnote in Pidal); the sense is probably 'they go about, spread' (a form of andar), or an adverb; no secure modern equivalent
ayudara: ayudar — he had helped (-ra form in its old pluperfect sense, 3rd sg.; que Dios le ayudara 'that God had helped him'; = había ayudado)
fiziera: fazer — he had made, done (-ra pluperfect, 3rd sg.; fiziera esta arrancada 'had brought about this rout'; = había hecho)
corredores: corredor — raider, outrider sent out to scour the country (masc. pl.; davan sus corredores 'he sent out his raiders'; = corredores, closest 'exploradores, incursores')
fazien: fazer — they were making, doing (imperfect 3rd pl.; fazien las trasnochadas 'they made the night-rides'; = hacían)
trasnochadas: trasnochada — night-ride, night march, raid by night (fem. pl.; fazien las trasnochadas; closest modern 'correrías nocturnas'; cf. trasnochar)
gujera: Gujera — Cullera, a coastal town and castle at the mouth of the Júcar south of Valencia (Pidal: Gujera is the Castilian-j pronunciation of Valencian Cullera; = Cullera)
xátiva: Xátiva — Játiva (Xàtiva), a town south-west of Valencia inland from Cullera (= Játiva)
ayusso: ayuso — down, farther down, i.e. farther south (adverb, Latin deorsum; aun mas ayusso 'still farther down'; = abajo; ayuso survives only as a literary archaism)
denia: Denia — a coastal town in Alicante province, south of Valencia (Pidal: Denia la casa 'the town of Denia'; = Denia)
quebranta: quebrantar — he breaks, ravages, lays waste (present 3rd sg., historic present; firme la quebranta 'he ravages it thoroughly'; = quebranta)
ganaron: ganar — they took, captured (preterite 3rd pl.; ganaron Peña Cadiella 'they captured Peña Cadiella'; = ganaron)
peña: peña — rock, crag (Peña Cadiella 'the rock of Cadiella'; = peña)
cadiella: Cadiella — second element of Peña Cadiella, the modern sierra de Benicadell on the Valencia/Alicante border (Pidal: Pennacatel, Peñacadell; the Cid rebuilt its castle in 1092; = Benicadell)
exidas: exida — way out, exit, sally (fem. pl., from exir; las exidas e las entradas 'the ways out and the ways in', i.e. the passes; = salidas)
entradas: entrada — way in, entrance, approach (fem. pl.; las exidas e las entradas; = entradas)
dolor: dolor — grief, pain, distress (masc.; el dolor de Valençia 'the distress of Valencia'; = dolor)
ganando: ganar — taking, winning (gerund; prendiendo e ganando 'seizing and taking'; = ganando)
durmiendo: dormir — sleeping (gerund; durmiendo los días 'sleeping by day'; = durmiendo)
tranochando: tranochar — riding through the night, going without sleep (gerund, variant of trasnochar; las noches tranochando 'riding at night'; = trasnochando)
villas: villa — town (fem. pl.; ganar aquellas villas 'to take those towns'; = villas)
escarmentados: escarmentar — taught a lesson, chastened, punished (past part. masc. pl., with han as perfect auxiliary; escarmentados los han 'they have taught them a lesson'; = escarmentados)
fueras: fueras — outside, out of doors (adverb, = fuera; fueras exir 'go outside'; = fuera, afuera)
tajávales: tajar + les — he cut down, he used to cut (imperfect 3rd sg., enclitic les 'to/against them'; tajávales las huertas 'he cut down their orchards'; = les talaba)
huertas: huerta — irrigated garden land, orchard (fem. pl.; = huertas)
fazíales: fazer + les — he did to them, he was doing (imperfect 3rd sg., enclitic les; fazíales grand mal 'did them great harm'; = les hacía)
destos: de + estos — of these (contraction; en cada uno destos años 'in each one of these years'; = de estos)
tollió: toller — he took away (preterite 3rd sg., -ió; Latin tollere; les tollió el pan 'took the bread from them'; = quitó)
aquexan: aquexar — they are hard pressed, distressed (se aquexan, reflexive, present 3rd pl.; mal se aquexan 'they are sorely pressed'; = se apuran, se afligen; modern aquejarse has shifted to 'to complain')
sabent: saber — they know (present 3rd pl., -ent form; non sabent ques far 'they do not know what to do'; = saben)
viníe: venir — it was coming, came (imperfect 3rd sg., -íe; non les viníe pan 'no bread came to them'; = venía)
da: dar — he gives (present 3rd sg.; nin da conssejo padre a fijo 'neither does father give help to son'; = da)
conssejo: conssejo — help, remedy (spelling variant of consejo; Pidal 'amparo, socorro'; = consejo)
fijo: fijo — son (masc. sg., Latin filius; a fijo 'to a son'; = hijo)
consolar: consolar — to console, comfort (infinitive; nos pueden consolar 'they can comfort one another'; = consolar)
señores: señor — lords, sirs (masc. pl., vocative; señores, as the poet's address to his audience; = señores)
murir: murir — to die (infinitive, with u for o in the stem; veer los murir 'to see them die'; = morir)
fanbre: fanbre — hunger, famine (fem.; murir de fanbre 'die of hunger'; = hambre, with f- kept)
veyen: veer — they saw, were seeing (imperfect 3rd pl., veyen = veíen, the y a glide between the vowels; delante veyen so duelo 'they saw their grief before them'; = veían)
huviar: huviar — to help, come to the aid of (infinitive; nin los vino huviar 'nor did he come to help them', Pidal 'ni les vino a ayudar'; = ayudar, socorrer)
marruecos: Marruecos — Morocco (rey de Marruecos 'the king of Morocco', i.e. the Almoravid ruler; = Marruecos)
montes: monte — mountain (masc. pl.; los Montes Claros; = montes)
claros: claro — clear, bright (adjective masc. pl.; Montes Claros: Pidal, an old name of the Atlas range, the poet anachronistically meaning the Almohad leader, whom he sets at war with the king of Morocco; = claros)
avíe: aver — he had, was having (imperfect 3rd sg., -íe; avíe guerra tan grand 'he was engaged in so great a war'; = tenía, había)
sópolo: saber + lo — he learned it, got to know it (strong preterite 3rd sg. sopo + enclitic lo; Sópolo mio Çid 'the Cid heard of it'; = lo supo)
amaneció: amanecer — it dawned, day broke (preterite 3rd sg.; amaneció a mio Çid en tierras de Mon Real 'day broke on the Cid in the lands of Mon Real'; = amaneció, here with the Cid as dative)
mon: mon — mount (apocopated mont, = monte; first element of Mon Real); Pidal gives no note here, but in his note on Mont Real at vv. 862–864 he identifies it as Monreal del Campo (Teruel), presumably the same place
navarra: Navarra — Navarre (por Aragón e por Navarra 'through Aragon and Navarre'; = Navarra)
pregón: pregón — public proclamation, crier's call (masc.; pregón mandó echar 'he ordered a proclamation to be made'; = pregón)
menssajes: menssaje — message, or the messenger who carries it (masc. pl.; enbió sos menssajes 'sent his messages'; = mensajes, mensajeros)
perder: perder — to lose, be rid of (infinitive; perder cueta 'to lose one's distress, escape want'; = perder)
rritad: rritad — uncertain: no note in Pidal; most likely a noun made on rico, 'riches, wealth' (venir a rritad 'come to riches'), set against cueta 'distress'; rr- the old spelling of initial r; = riqueza (if so)
viniesse: venir — let him come, (that he) come (imperfect subjunctive 3rd sg. used as an indirect command; viniesse a mio Çid 'let him come to the Cid'; = viniese)
premia: premia — compulsion, constraint (noun; ninguno non ha premia 'no one is under compulsion'; = apremio, coacción)
speraré: esperar — I will wait for (future 1st sg., with e- lost; tres días le speraré 'I shall wait three days for him'; = esperaré)
tornávas: tornar + se — he went back, returned (imperfect 3rd sg. tornava + -s(e); Tornávas a Murviedro 'he went back to Murviedro'; = se tornaba, se volvía)
ganada: ganar — taken, won (past part. fem. sg., agreeing with the object la; ganada se la a 'he has taken it for himself'; = ganada)
detardar: detardar — to delay, put off (infinitive; non lo quiso detardar 'he would not put it off'; = tardar, demorar)
creçiendo: creçer — growing (gerund; creçiendo va riqueza 'wealth keeps growing'; ir + gerund; = creciendo)
compeçós: conpeçar + se — he began (preterite 3rd sg. + -s(e); compeçós de pagar 'he began to be pleased', conpeçar de + inf.; pagarse here 'to be pleased, satisfied'; = comenzó a, se puso a)
sobrellas: sobre + ellas — upon them (fem. pl.; sobrellas va echar 'he goes to cast himself upon them', i.e. to lay siege; the antecedent of ellas is not clear, perhaps Valencia and its lands; uncertain; cf. sobrella)
avía: aver — there was, it had (imperfect 3rd sg.; que non i avía hart 'for there was no flaw in it'; = había)
hart: hart — uncertain: Pidal's note on this line reads it as art, 'trick, flaw, loophole' (sin art 'without deceit', then 'perfectly'; 'non i avía art' = 'there was no defect', the siege was perfect); = arte, closest 'falla, resquicio'
viédales: vedar + les — he forbids them, bars them (present 3rd sg., diphthongized, historic present; viédales exir e viédales entrar 'he barred them from going out and coming in'; = les veda)
meses: mes — month (masc. pl.; nueve meses complidos 'nine full months'; = meses)
complidos: complido — full, complete, finished (past part. of complir, masc. pl.; nueve meses complidos 'nine months full'; = cumplidos)
yaz: yazer — he lies, lay (encamped) (present 3rd sg., historic present; sobrella yaz 'lay before it'; = yace)
dezeno: dezeno — tenth (ordinal; el dezeno [mes] 'the tenth month'; = décimo)
oviérongela: aver + gela — they had to give it to him (ovieron, preterite 3rd pl., + gela = ge 'to him' + la 'it'; oviérongela a dar, aver a + inf. 'to have to'; = tuvieron que dársela)
gozos: gozo — joy, rejoicing (masc. pl.; grandes son los gozos 'great is the rejoicing'; = gozos)
çibdad: çibdad — city (fem.; entró en la çibdad 'entered the city'; = ciudad)
podrie: poder — he could, would be able (conditional 3rd sg., -ie; ¿quien vos lo podrie contar? 'who could tell it to you?'; = podría)
cabdal: cabdal — chief, principal (adjective; seña cabdal 'the chief banner'; = caudal as 'principal', now mainly a noun 'wealth, flow')
sedié: seer — it was set, stood (imperfect 3rd sg., -ié; seer 'to sit, be', Latin sedere; sedié en somo del alcáçer 'stood on top of the citadel'; = estaba)
alcáçer: alcáçer — citadel, fortress (Arabic al-qaṣr; en somo del alcáçer 'on top of the citadel'; = alcázar)

__broaden__.ques: que + se — who ... themselves (que, relative pronoun, + reflexive se; los ques pudieron escapar 'those who managed to escape'; = los que se pudieron escapar) · also ques — qué + se, 'what … to' (interrogative que + se; non sabent ques far 'they know not what to do', as qué se far at v. 1155; no note in Pidal; = qué hacer)
__broaden__.nos: nos — we (subject pronoun; = nosotros) · also nos — us, to us (object pronoun; atorgar nos hedes 'you will grant us') · also reflexive 'ourselves' (nos partimos 'we part'); dative (la missa nos dirá 'will say for us') · also nos' — non + se (aun nos' van del campo 'they are still not leaving the field'; the apostrophe marks the elision) · also nos — non + se, written without apostrophe (nin amigo a amigo nos pueden consolar 'nor can friend console friend'; mas le vienen … que nos le van 'more come to him than leave him', the no redundant after the comparison)
__broaden__.ovieron: aver — they had, they got (strong preterite of aver; = hubieron) · also ovieron a + inf. — 'they had to, were obliged to' (ovieron a enbiar 'they had to send'; = tuvieron que enviar)
__broaden__.quien: quien — who, whom (relative pronoun, also with a plural antecedent; = quien, quienes) · also quien — 'whoever, he who' (quien quiere perder cueta 'whoever wishes to lose distress'); interrogative 'who?' (¿quien vos lo podrie contar? 'who could tell it you?'; = quién)
__broaden__.les: les — to them · also les — 'from them', dative of removal or injury (les tollió el pan 'took the bread from them'; viédales exir 'forbids them to go out')
__broaden__.recabdo: recabdo — care, precaution, strict order (= recaudo) · also recabdo — business secured, a sure outcome (con todo buen recabdo 'with everything well in hand') · recabdo — account, reckoning (oro e plata que non saben recabdo 'gold and silver past all reckoning') · also con recabdo — within bounds, under control (non es con recabdo el dolor de Valençia 'the grief of Valencia is past all bounds')
__broaden__.echar: echar — to cast out, put out (infinitive; los manda echar 'orders them put out'; = echar) · also echar pregón — to have a proclamation cried (pregón mandó echar) · echar(se) sobre — to throw oneself upon, lay siege to (sobrellas va echar)
__broaden__.mingua: minguar — it lacks, is wanting (present 3rd sg.; que nada nol mingua 'so that nothing is wanting to it'; = menguar, whence mengua 'lack') · also mingua — want, lack (noun; aver mingua de pan 'to be short of bread'; = mengua)
__broaden__.çerca: çerca — near; here adverbial, çerca o tarde = 'sooner or later' (= cerca) · also çerca — siege, encirclement (noun; en çerca 'under siege'; = cerco) · also çercar — he besieges (present 3rd sg.; bien la çerca mio Çid 'my Çid besieges it well'; = cerca)
__broaden__.fazen: fazer — they make, give (present 3rd pl.; grand yantar le fazen 'they give him a great feast'; = hacen) · also fazerse — to become (cavalleros se fazen 'they become knights'; = se hacen)
__broaden__.duró: durar — it lasted (preterite 3rd sg.; = duró) · also durar — he spent, took (time) (en ganar aquellas villas mio Çid duró tres años; Pidal 'tardó, empleó, gastó')
__broaden__.davan: dar — they were giving (imperfect 3rd pl.; salto davan 'they made a dash'; = daban) · also dar — 'to deal blows' (sin piedad les davan 'they struck them without mercy') · also dar — to send out, dispatch (davan sus corredores; Pidal 'enviaban, despachaban')
__broaden__.que: que — that, who, which; for · also por que — because, since (= porque) · por que — by which, whereby (por que más valdrá 'whereby he will be worth more') · also que — 'so that, lest' introducing purpose/result (que por miedo non dexen nada; por tal lo faze … que no lo ventasse nadi); after después/mientra 'after, while' (después que, mientra que) · also que — than, after a comparative (mas le vienen … que nos le van 'more come to him than leave him')
